subject: Medivise POC kickoff recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Torres <claire.torres@medivise.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medivise.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Medivise POC kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Claire & Raj 

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Below we're all aligned ahead of the POC kickoff next week. I've attached a short scope doc and an access checklist for your infra team.

Key pain points you reiterated:
- Inconsistent summarization and extraction from patient triage notes (high variability across clinicians).
- Current vendor's latency at peak times prevents near-real-time triage routing.
- Cost per inference is ballooning with current black-box approach.

POC goals / success metrics (agreed):
1) Accuracy: Entity extraction F1 >= 0.85 on the provided evaluation set (50k lines, see prompt_set in doc).
2) Latency: 95th percentile <= 350ms for 512-token context on an avg request mix.
3) Cost: Token cost reduction >= 35% vs current baseline for production-like load.
4) Quality guardrails: Reduce hallucination incidents on patient-safety fields to <1% on spot checks.

Scope & what Redwood will deliver during the POC:
- Deployment: Hosted POC environment on dedicated pools configured to mimic your prod request mix.
- Prompt set & evals: We'll run your submitted prompt set (see attached) and run automated evals on the labeled set.
- Integration: Simple API integration for inference + optional webhook for classified outputs.
- Monitoring: Token-level cost & latency dashboards, and weekly quality regressions report.

Owners & timeline:
- Medivise PM owner: Claire Torres 
— overall POC lead and evaluation signoff.
- Medivise Eng owner: Raj Patel 
— infra access and SSO/KMS coordination.
- Redwood AE: Marissa Cole 
— commercial lead, kickoff coordination.
- Redwood SE: Neha Kapoor 
— technical lead, model config, and evals.
- Redwood Eng lead: Aditya Rao 
— runtime tuning and quantization recommendations.

Timeline (target):
- Week 0 (Apr 12-16): Access & infra setup; share sample dataset and S3 access.
- Week 1 (Apr 19-23): Prompt set run, baseline evals, initial latency/cost configs.
- Week 2 (Apr 26-30): Iteration on prompt configs, quantization tests, and perf tuning.
- Week 3 (May 3-7): Finalize POC report and present results; decision meeting May 10.

Immediate asks for your team (action items):
1) Provide S3 read-only path or signed samples and a service account for retrieval (Raj).
2) Confirm compliance contacts so we can pre-populate SOC 2 artifact requests (Claire).
3) Approve the scoped eval metrics above (Claire 
— quick thumbs up is fine).

Next steps: I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff meeting for Monday Apr 12 at 10:00am PT (calendar invite to follow). I've attached the POC scope and an access checklist for your infra team.

Attachments: medivise-poc-scope.pdf, access-checklist.md

Thanks 
Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192


Redwood Inference

From: Claire Torres <claire.torres@medivise.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medivise POC kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the clear summary and timeline. Confirming the key goals look right to us. A couple quick clarifications:
- For the F1 target, the labeled set we can share is ~45k rows; is that sufficient?
- On latency: the 512-token context is our typical long case; we also have many short notes (~128 tokens) 
— would Redwood expect substantially lower p95 there?

Action items from our side:
- Raj will create a read-only service account and provision a signed URL to a sample S3 folder by EOD Apr 12.
- I'll share our SOC contact (Elena Morales) to start the artifact collection.

We're good to proceed with the kickoff on Apr 12 10am PT. Looking forward to the partner kickoff.

Best,
Claire Torres
Product Manager | Medivise
claire.torres@medivise.com
